records.title: GigaWorld-0: World Models as Data Engine to Empower Embodied AI
records.reason: GigaWorld-0 builds world models/data for embodied AI; its target is robotic learning, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: HaluMem: Evaluating Hallucinations in Memory Systems of Agents
records.reason: HaluMem is a benchmark measuring hallucinations and runtime of agent memory systems; it adds no inference optimization method.

records.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and Beyond: A Comprehensive Survey on How to Make your LLMs use External Data More Wisely
records.reason: This is a comprehensive RAG/external-data survey, not a new method or measured inference optimization; topic is related but not an actionable efficiency contribution itself.

records.title: LITA: Language Instructed Temporal-Localization Assistant
records.reason: LITA addresses video temporal localization capability, not inference compute, memory, or serving.

records.title: Multimodal learning with next-token prediction for large multimodal models
records.reason: Nature article presents Emu3 multimodal next-token model and states its current decoding is naive and could be accelerated later; it contributes no such inference optimization.
